test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘OFFCUTS’ is written as ‘LUUXDEF’ and ‘PARADOX’ is written as ‘KZIZUJA’. How will ‘NAILING’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c07bcee6e55e2bd7985f394379969d1b2ca41acf672ee3c98278b3104cf2bf2.png] 

The Logic applied here is:

Logic: The letters code thus formed in the code is exactly 

Opposite to the letters in the original word.

OFFCUTS → LUUXDEF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4da57b5550cc67b6ba7ab7769e1d2d958e0e65c94f608cf3594c7822e432762.png] 

PARADOX → KZIZUJA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa23df3291d23c923a84fb6ecab065dd2c2b5f4e8f4670849055e3bc6ffd6721.png] 

 

Similarly,

NAILING → MZROPKR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f825dfc029142415723609836c7ce0e56283c73daadfb01929d317ca75bf21b.png] 

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 4"**
